summary: Implemented the sole authorized Fable Proposal 3 bounded test using the serialized Generation-28 depth-one factors and their literal tensor squares. The alleged NO seed is exactly permutation-isometric to the matched control by swapping assignment coordinates 0 and 7 in both bags. Tensoring that permutation pairs every unrestricted integer coefficient matrix, so R_1=R_2=1 and the required strict ratio growth fails. This is finite evidence about this seed pair only.
hypothesis: Literal Kronecker products of a frozen deep-hole seed might increase the exact NO/YES squared-distance ratio from R_1 to R_2>R_1; falsification was R_2<=R_1 or an unrestricted entangled shortcut.

tests.finding: Verified exact seed and tensor permutation isometries, R_1=R_2=1, the [-60,60] coefficient bound through squared radius 31285, named DROP/G13/G19/malformed attacks, and all 131585 integer matrices with l1 norm at most two.
The verifier compiles and the emitted seed/product manifest is valid JSON.
The Generation-28 source construction still verifies after reuse by the tensor experiment.

next_experiment: If literal tensoring is continued, first freeze a genuinely nonisometric constant-rank NO/YES seed with R_1>1; then derive a product-shell coefficient bound and require an unrestricted k=2 search to prove R_2>R_1, killing immediately on equality, a DROP/G13/G19 state, or a non-rank-one shortcut.
